schedules.title: CVPen daily growth opportunities
schedules.prompt: Prepare a practical daily growth brief for CVPen, an ATS-focused CV improvement service in Egypt. Include 3 offer/content experiments, one low-cost acquisition channel, a draft CTA, and measurable KPIs. Do not invent demand or conversion data. Separate hypotheses from verified facts.

schedules.title: QudSystem social content draft
schedules.prompt: Create one useful Arabic Egyptian social post for QudSystem about custom software, AI automation, websites, dashboards, or business process improvement. Avoid hype and fear. Include a clear business problem, concrete solution, proof requirements, CTA, and 3 hashtags. Draft only; do not publish.

schedules.title: Short-form video concept and script
schedules.prompt: Create one 30-45 second vertical video concept for QudSystem or CVPen. Deliver hook, storyboard, Egyptian Arabic voiceover, on-screen text, B-roll/editing notes, English subtitle translation, and CTA. Keep production possible with a phone and free tools. Do not claim a video was rendered.

schedules.title: Target customer segments and outreach drafts
schedules.prompt: Identify best-fit customer segments for QudSystem web/software/AI automation services and CVPen in Egypt. Produce an ICP, qualification questions, ethical public-source research plan, and personalized outreach templates. Never fabricate named leads, contact details, or claim anyone was contacted.

schedules.title: QudSystem SEO improvement plan
schedules.prompt: Create a prioritized SEO plan for a small Egyptian software and AI company targeting Egypt and English-speaking international customers. Include service-page structure, search-intent clusters, technical SEO checks, internal linking, and a 4-week content roadmap. Flag anything requiring live website inspection.
